messages:
alex_customer: Hi team — our per-model throughput sparklines in Console dropped to flatlines ~10:15 UTC. API is still serving, usage counts look normal, but graphs show zeros. Anyone seen this?

maria_support: Thanks for flagging, Alex. Can you share org id and a screenshot? Escalating to eng-platform/oncall. @sam_eng-platform @lee_oncall

metricsbot: Alert fired: grafana_panel_no_series - console.prod.per_model_throughput - 2026-03-10T10:17:12Z

sam_eng-platform: looking now. Do you see client errors or spikes in latency?

alex_customer: No client errors, p50 ~40ms, p95 ~120ms. Screenshot: https://redwood.link/snap/abc123 (shows all model lines flat)

lee_oncall: quick check — can you curl the exporter and grep for model labels? `curl -sS https://metrics.internal/exporter/metrics | grep exporter_model_throughput`

alex_customer: ran that, pasted the top lines:
```
# HELP exporter_model_throughput tokens/sec
exporter_model_throughput{model="gpt-redwood-v1",instance="gpu-12"} 0.0
exporter_model_throughput{model="gpt-redwood-v2",instance="gpu-13"} 0.0
```

lee_oncall: values 0.0 from exporter — hmm. Is the exporter actually returning zero, or is Grafana filtering wrong?

sam_eng-platform: checking deploy history — we rolled exporter 2026-03-09 22:03 UTC with a metrics refactor. We renamed label `model_name` -> `model` and bumped namespace to `redwood_metrics_v2`. Grafana dashboards still query `model_name`. That would return no series for per-model panels.

maria_support: ok that matches symptoms: console panels filter on `model_name` so they show nothing, while raw exporter may still export under new label `model` (but values zero in Alex's curl is weird).

sam_eng-platform: the 0.0 values are from the scrape aggregation (zero because not aggregated correctly). The critical issue is label key mismatch. Short-term: update dashboard queries to use `model` or add a `label_replace` fallback. Longer-term: exporter should emit compatibility labels or we add relabeling in scrape config.

lee_oncall: quick patch suggestion for Grafana panel: replace occurrences of `model_name` with `label_replace(model, "model_name", "$1", "model", "(.*)")` OR simpler: use `by (model)` grouping. Will push a staging change in ~10m.

maria_support: opened INC-4821 and added eng-platform + eng-sre + customer link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4821

maria_support: Action items: (1) eng-platform deploy grafana query update to staging (sam), (2) eng-sre add relabel rule to keep `model_name` alias in scrape config (lee), (3) support follow up with customer and confirm.

sam_eng-platform: deploying Grafana panel patch to staging now, will promote to prod on successful smoke.

metricsbot: Deployment: grafana-dash-ops v2.3.1 -> staging - started

maria_support: Alex, ETA 30-45m for full fix. Sorry for the disruption, we'll update as soon as dashboards show data.

alex_customer: thanks — appreciate the quick reaction :thumbsup:

sam_eng-platform: PROD patch applied, panels updated to use `model`. Please refresh the Console dashboard.

maria_support: 2026-03-10T11:02:30Z - confirmed with Alex that lines returned, closing incident after 1h monitoring.

alex_customer: confirmed graphs back to normal. Thanks all!
